_comment: Curated SuperVaultCounsel fleet configuration - the source of truth for 'all strategies' (NOT the full aggregator registry, which includes third-party/test vaults). Per environment: the operator Safe, the immutable deviation-threshold bounds, and the strategy list per chain. Every listed strategy is validated against the on-chain aggregator registry at run time. If a chain's strategy list is EMPTY, runAll falls back to the full on-chain registry (intended for staging/test environments only).

prod._operatorNote: MUST be set to the real operator Safe before any prod BROADCAST (simulate works with a placeholder; address(0) reverts only on broadcast)
prod._vetoRegistryNote: address(0) = veto authority defaults to SuperGovernor.isGuardian; set to a custom IVetoRegistry (e.g. Newton attestation shim) to plug per-instance veto authority

staging._operatorNote: Staging placeholder (v2 deployer EOA) - fine for testing flows; not a Safe
